entries.name: Fixed-timestep game loop scheduler (MainLoop.js animate)
entries.flow_role: Step 9 (döngü kontrolü): confirm the chosen physics step (default 1000/60 ms) runs 1 update per frame at 60 Hz, catches up at 30 Hz, and that a tab-switch stall triggers panic + discard instead of a spiral. The step value is written into the HTML (G012), whose embedded loop is the upstream mainloop.min.js.

entries.name: Top-down tile city generator (roads, sidewalks, buildings, parks, points of interest)
entries.flow_role: Step 1 (harita): the first call of the flow; every later step reads its tiles and points.

entries.name: 2D vehicle kinematics (kinematic bicycle model: accelerate, brake, steer)
entries.flow_role: Step 3 (araç ayarı): test-drive the player car with the chosen parameters; the final params and speed_limits go to the HTML builder (G012). The JavaScript runtime in G012 implements this exact update and the end-to-end test compares the two.

entries.name: 2D collision detection and push-out vector (SAT.js: circles, boxes, convex polygons)
entries.flow_role: Step 11 (çarpışma kontrolü): check that spawn points do not sit inside buildings and define the push-out rule the game uses for car-vs-building tiles. The HTML runtime (G012) uses the same circle-vs-box formula; the end-to-end test compares them.

entries.name: A* path finding on a tile grid (python-pathfinding)
entries.flow_role: Step 2 (rotalar): on the map from G002, compute pedestrian routes on the walk grid and traffic routes on the drive grid, and in step 6 prove every mission target is reachable by car. The paths are embedded in the HTML; the browser never runs A*.

entries.name: NPC steering behaviours: seek, flee, arrive, pursuit (Yuka)
entries.flow_role: Step 4 (NPC ve polis davranışı): tune pedestrian arrive (walking between route waypoints), traffic seek and police pursuit; check that police at the chosen speed can catch a car that stops but not one at full speed. The JavaScript runtime in G012 uses the same formulas; the end-to-end test compares them.

entries.name: Wanted level (0-5 stars) and police response rules
entries.flow_role: Step 5 (aranma kuralları): fix the rule table and replay a sample chase to confirm stars rise and fall as intended; the rules object goes into the HTML (G012), whose runtime applies the same rules each frame.

entries.name: Mission chain validation and mission state machine (goto, deliver, escape, collect)
entries.flow_role: Step 6 (görevler): build missions from the map landmarks (G002), validate the chain, check every target tile is reachable by car (G005 on the drive grid), and replay a scripted run; the validated list goes into the HTML (G012).

entries.name: Game economy: wallet, shop catalog and inventory ledger
entries.flow_role: Step 7 (ekonomi): set the starting money and shop catalog, replay mission rewards and a few purchases to check prices make sense; the catalog and start money go into the HTML (G012).

entries.name: Save and load game state (versioned JSON envelope with FNV-1a checksum)
entries.flow_role: Step 10 (kayıt biçimi): save the starting state of the game to fix the save format; the end-to-end test saves from the browser runtime and loads it with this tool to prove both sides agree.

entries.name: Procedural sound effects with ZzFX (horn, crash, siren, pickup, cash, mission, wasted, engine)
entries.flow_role: Step 8 (sesler): pick one sound per game event (horn, crash, siren, pickup, cash, mission_complete, wasted), check none clips (peak <= 1) and is longer than intended, then pass the parameter bank to G012. The HTML embeds ZzFXMicro (MIT) and plays zzfx(...params) on the event.

entries.name: Self-contained HTML5 canvas game builder (top-down city driving game)
entries.flow_role: Step 12 (HTML üret): the last skill call; the runner writes result.html to index.html, then verifies it (no external URLs, JavaScript syntax, a headless run of the game loop).
